subject: Upcoming Event Details
body: Dear Team, I am excited to share the details of our upcoming team-building event. The event will take place at the local park on Saturday, July 24th from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Please bring your own snacks and drinks. We will have team games, a barbecue, and a fun photo booth. Let's have a great time bonding and enjoying the outdoors together. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best, [Your Name]
